main_text.p: telligentissimus, Jesa.27.11. Chald. בִּינָה Intelligentia, Dan.2.21.

תִּבוּנָה f. Idem: Aff. לִתְבוּנָתוֹ Intelligetia ejus, Psal.147. v.5. בִּתְבוּנָם Pro intellectu suo, Hos.13.2. quod contractum est, pro בִּתְבוּנָתָם ; vide simile in בִּינָה inter Nomina ; Plural. תְּבוּנוֹת Prudentia, Intelligentia, Jesa.40.14. Aff. עַד־תְּבוּנוֹתֵיכֶם Usq; ad intelligentias vestras, sive sensa vestra, Job.32.11.

בּוּס Calcavit, Conculcavit, Proculcavit: Futur. וָאָבוֹס Et calcavi, Jesa.63.6. Pih. Praeter. בִּסֵּס Conculcant, Jes.63.18. Jer.12.10. Hoph. Particip. מוּבָס Proculcatum, Jesa.14.19. Hithp. Partic. fœm. מִתְבּוֹסֶסֶת Conculcandum prebens te, Ezech.16.6.
בּוּס masc. Conculcans, Nomen participiale transitivum, ut Kimchi notat in lib. Rad. Unde Plural. בּוֹסִים Conculcantes, Zach.10.5.
תִּבּוֹסָה f. Idem: Constr. תְּבוּסַת אַחֲזִיָּהוּ Proculcatio Achasia, 2.Par.22.7.
בּוּץ m. Byssus, Bysinum; 1.Par.15.27. בֻּץ Vide in בּוּץ.
בּוֹק מְבוּקָה, בּוּקָה f. Vacuitas, Evacuatio, Nah.2.10. Reliqua quæ hinc esse possint, vide in בָּקַק.

בּוֹר Fovea, Exod.21.33. Cisterna aquarum collectarum, 2.Reg.18.31. Carcer, proprie subterraneus, Jesa.38.8. Sepulchrum, Psal.28.1. Hebræi notant, proprie esse Cisternam rotundam, & inde latius extenditur. Interdum scribitur cum א in medio, מְבָאֵר De cisterna, 2.Sam.23.15.20. Plural. בֹּרוֹת Cisternæ, Deuter.6.11. & בְּאֵרוֹת Jerem.2.13.

page.notes: Hebrew words are copied from the scan and may contain errors in vowel points or letters; those I could not read with confidence are not individually marked, so check the Hebrew against the original. The running head and the signature are uncertain readings. The top-left "67" is taken as the page number. The line ending "parago-" is a hyphenated word that continues on the next page; the page number at the top is printed as 67. Long s is written as plain s throughout, so "Jesa" stands for printed "Jefa". The Latin italics are approximate where the scan is faint.
